voice.name: en-US-GuyNeural
voice.prosody: HYPE token. Let's talk about it.
This thing is up two hundred and eighteen percent in six months. Two. One. Eight. Percent. Are you kidding me?!
May alone? Up eighty-two percent. From forty dollars to seventy-two. Absolute. Monster.
Here is the deal. Right now HYPE is consolidating around seventy-one dollars. It hit an all-time high of seventy-seven dollars on June sixteenth. Then it pulled back.
Normal. Healthy. This is what winners do before the next leg up.
Multi-timeframe check. Daily chart? Bullish. RSI at sixty-one. MACD positive. Price above every moving average. The trend is your friend and this trend is strong.
Hourly chart? Corrective. That is fine. That is expected. Price is building a base between seventy and seventy-three. This is coiling. This is spring-loading. When it breaks, it is going to rip.

Key levels. Support at sixty-eight to seventy. That is your buy zone. That is where you want to be. Resistance at seventy-four. Break above that and we are retesting seventy-seven. Break seventy-seven and we are looking at eighty. Then eighty-five.

The volume story is beautiful. Volume spiked on the rally. Peak day was thirty-two million. Now volume is drying up as price coils. Low volume consolidation after high volume expansion? That is textbook continuation.
Bottom line. Sixty percent probability this resolves up. The higher timeframe trend is intact. The correction is orderly. No panic selling. This is accumulation. Not distribution.
My advice? Watch sixty-eight to seventy. That is the zone. If it holds, you load up. If it breaks seventy-four with volume, you add.
This is not financial advice. But this chart is speaking. Are you listening?
